ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A uniform magnetic field of magnitude, $0.50 \, \mathrm{T}$, lies on the $x$-$y$ plane making a $60^\circ$ angle with the $x$-axis. When a $1.2 \, \mu\mathrm{C}$ point charge moves in the $+y$ direction, it experiences a force of magnitude, $3.0 \, \mu\mathrm{N}$. What is the speed of the charged particle?

The problem gives that the velocity direction of the charged particle is +y, therefore the included angle between the velocity direction and the magnetic field direction is 90° - 60° = 30°. Use the magnetic force magnitude formula F = |q| v B sin(theta). Substituting F = 3.0e-6 N, q = 1.2e-6 C, B = 0.50 T, theta = 30°, gives v = F/(|q| B sin30°) = 3.0e-6 / (1.2e-6 * 0.50 * 0.5) = 10 m/s.

method.method_draft: Use the angle form of the magnetic force. From the text, take B = 0.50 T, q = 1.2 microC, F = 3.0 microN, and velocity direction +y. From the image, read that B is 60 degrees above the +x-axis, so the angle between B and the +y velocity direction is 90 degrees - 60 degrees = 30 degrees. Apply F = |q| v B sin(theta), then solve v = F/(|q| B sin 30 degrees) = 3.0e-6/(1.2e-6 * 0.50 * 0.5) = 10 m/s.

method.method_draft: Resolve the magnetic field into components relative to the particle velocity. From the text, the charge moves along +y, so only the component of B perpendicular to +y can produce magnetic force. From the image/text, B makes 60 degrees with +x, so B_x = B cos 60 degrees = 0.50 * 0.5 = 0.25 T and B_y is parallel to the velocity and contributes no force. Use F = |q| v B_perp = |q| v B_x. Thus v = F/(|q|B_x) = 3.0e-6/(1.2e-6 * 0.25) = 10 m/s.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示 x 轴水平向右、y 轴竖直向上，灰色平行箭头表示均匀磁场 B。磁场方向位于 x-y 平面内，并与 +x 轴成 60° 角。

推理：带电粒子沿 +y 方向运动，因此磁场中与 +y 方向平行的分量不产生磁力，只有垂直于 +y 方向的分量产生磁力。由于 B 与 +x 轴成 60°，其 x 分量为 B_x = B cos 60° = 0.50 T × 0.5 = 0.25 T。这个 B_x 分量垂直于粒子的速度方向，所以 B_perp = 0.25 T。磁力大小满足 F = |q| v B_perp，因此 v = F / (|q| B_perp)。代入 F = 3.0 × 10^-6 N，|q| = 1.2 × 10^-6 C，B_perp = 0.25 T，得到 v = (3.0 × 10^-6) / [(1.2 × 10^-6)(0.25)] = 10 m/s。
